The Ubuntu Podcast

A weekly Linux and open-source chat from the Ubuntu UK community, recorded by three presenters in their own homes and released every Thursday. Below you will find a season overview, the show facts, and a feedback form.

Ubuntu Podcast

FormatTalk show on Linux and free software
PresentersAlan Pope, Mark Johnson, Martin Wimpress
LanguageEnglish
AudioMP3 (Ogg Vorbis until Series 10)
Years activeMarch 2008 to September 2021
SeasonsFourteen, roughly forty episodes each
ScheduleWeekly, recorded Tuesday, out Thursday
Based inEngland, United Kingdom
